description: This file contains the implementation of the ApplicationInfoService interface in a Spring-based Java application. It provides a method to retrieve application information, throwing exceptions if data inconsistencies are found.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ApplicationInfoService interface, providing application info retrieval logic with validation.

methods.name: getAppInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the single AppInfo object from the repository, throwing BusinessException if the data is null, empty, or contains multiple entries.
